heading_path: Part 13—Importation of goods infringing Australian trade marks
13.6  Period for compliance with request of ComptrollerGeneral of Customs for information etc.
text: For the purposes of subsection 143(2) of the Act (which deals with giving information to the ComptrollerGeneral of Customs), the period for complying with a request under subsection 143(1) of the Act is 10 working days from the day on which the request is made.
